description: Synthetic evaluation corpus for search stages 5 and 6. All items, folders, codes and numbers are invented. Small and not a benchmark. Stage 6 added folders and the item fields folder, level, type, action_type and parent. The items and their texts did not change.

items.title: Sample MS-0417: Mo/Si multilayer, 40 periods on Si(100)
items.description: Magnetron sputtering run with Mo and Si targets. Argon pressure 2.0 mTorr, Mo target 150 W DC, Si target 300 W RF. Target period 6.9 nm, gamma 0.4. Deposition took 3 h 10 min.

files.name: MS-0417_log.txt
files.text: Run MS-0417. Base pressure 3e-7 mbar. Rotation 20 rpm. Mo rate 0.052 nm/s, Si rate 0.081 nm/s. Shutter calibration done before the run. No arcing observed.

items.title: Напыление MS-0418: Mo/Si с барьерными слоями B4C
items.description: Многослойная структура Mo/B4C/Si/B4C, 50 периодов, толщина барьера 0,4 нм. Барьерные слои вводились для уменьшения перемешивания на границах раздела.

items.title: Argon pressure series for Mo single layers
items.description: Mo films of 50 nm were deposited at 0.8, 1.5, 2.5 and 4.0 mTorr. Film density falls and roughness grows when the pressure goes up. Best compromise is 1.5 mTorr.

items.title: Снижение внутренних напряжений в многослойных плёнках
items.description: Сжимающие напряжения в плёнке Mo/Si снижаются при повышении давления аргона и при введении тонкого слоя Cr. Кривизну подложки измеряли профилометром до и после напыления.

items.title: W/B4C multilayer for hard X-rays: first test run
items.description: Test deposition of a W/B4C stack, 100 periods, period 2.5 nm. The stack was completed and the reflectivity was measured at 8.05 keV. Result: peak reflectivity 62 percent.

items.title: Plan: Cr/Sc multilayer for the water window
items.description: Proposed work, not started. Deposit Cr/Sc with period 3.2 nm for 3.1 nm wavelength. We need a clean Sc target and a new rotation fixture. Start after the target arrives.

items.title: Калибровка скоростей напыления кварцевым датчиком
items.description: Скорость напыления Mo и Si определяли по кварцевому микровесам. Расхождение с толщиной по рентгеновской рефлектометрии составило менее 3 процентов.

items.title: Shutter timing error found in the deposition controller
items.description: Layer thickness was off by 0.15 nm because the shutter closed 0.4 s late. Firmware setting was corrected. All runs between February and March should be treated with care.

items.title: Ni/C multilayers for soft X-rays: results
items.description: Ni/C stacks with period 4.5 nm showed good contrast. The carbon layers were smooth. Measured peak reflectivity at 0.154 nm was 71 percent. The run was completed last week.

items.title: Планируется: осаждение La/B для длины волны 6,7 нм
items.description: Работа предложена, но не начата. Нужно подготовить мишень La и проверить совместимость с бором. Решение о закупке мишени ещё не принято.

items.title: Substrate temperature effect on Mo/Si interdiffusion
items.description: Samples grown on cooled substrates (10 C) show thinner interfacial silicide layers than samples grown at 80 C. The effect is small but reproducible. Cooling stage was added to the holder.

items.title: Реактивное напыление: нитрид кремния как барьер
items.description: Тонкий слой Si3N4 получали реактивным распылением в смеси аргона и азота. Доля азота 15 процентов. Слой оказался стабильнее, чем карбидный барьер.

items.title: Target utilisation and erosion track of the Mo cathode
items.description: The erosion groove on the 3 inch Mo cathode reached 4 mm depth. Utilisation is about 28 percent. Replacement is advised after 120 kWh of operation.

items.title: MS-0421 reference: single Mo layer, 30 nm, for optical constants
items.description: Thick reference film for the ellipsometry fit. Deposited at 1.5 mTorr. File mo_30nm_ref.dat stores the measured spectrum.

items.title: Влияние мощности магнетрона на шероховатость кремния
items.description: При увеличении ВЧ мощности на мишени Si шероховатость аморфного слоя растёт с 0,25 до 0,41 нм. Оптимальная мощность 250-300 Вт.

items.title: Multilayer without the buffer layer: delamination did not occur
items.description: Six Mo/Si stacks were grown directly on bare silicon. After two weeks no peeling or blistering was found on any of them. Adhesion was good without a buffer.

items.title: Delamination of Mo/Si on glass substrates
items.description: Stacks grown on float glass peeled off at the edges after 10 days in air. A chromium adhesion layer of 5 nm solved the problem in the next batch.

items.title: Планируется ионная полировка слоёв Si
items.description: Предложено добавить ионную полировку каждого кремниевого слоя пучком Ar+ с энергией 200 эВ. Эксперимент не проводился, нужна ионная пушка.

items.title: Gamma ratio optimisation for 13.5 nm mirrors
items.description: Scan of gamma from 0.30 to 0.50 showed the highest calculated reflectivity at gamma = 0.40 for Mo/Si with 6.9 nm period. The measured peak agreed within 1 percent.

items.title: Журнал запуска MS-0422: сбой вращения подложки
items.description: Во время напыления остановился привод вращения. Партия забракована. Причина: износ подшипника. Подшипник заменён, прогон повторён как MS-0423.

items.title: Deposition rate drift over a week
items.description: Rate of the Si magnetron dropped by 6 percent during one week. Recalibration before every run is now required. A log table of drift is attached.

items.title: Sample MS-0430: aperiodic multilayer for broadband reflection
items.description: Depth-graded Mo/Si stack with 60 layers designed for a flat response between 12.5 and 14.5 nm. The stack was deposited and checked by XRR.

items.title: Расчётные профили многослойных зеркал для мягкого рентгена
items.description: Выполнен расчёт профилей толщин для широкополосного зеркала. Расчёт использует оптические константы Хенке. Результаты ещё не проверены экспериментом.

items.title: Sputtering chamber leak check after venting
items.description: Helium leak test found a leak at the viewport flange. Rate was 2e-8 mbar l/s. The copper gasket was replaced and the leak rate fell below 1e-10.

items.title: Mo/Si with carbon-free barrier: thermal test pending
items.description: Samples MS-0440 to MS-0444 are ready for the annealing test. The test has not started. The oven is booked for next Tuesday.

items.title: Magnetron power supply replacement
items.description: The old RF generator was replaced with a new 600 W unit. Matching network retuned. Reflected power stays below 2 W at 300 W forward.

items.title: Рекомендации по подготовке мишеней перед напылением
items.description: Перед каждой серией мишень распыляют 10 минут при закрытой заслонке. Это удаляет оксидную плёнку и стабилизирует скорость.

items.title: Thickness uniformity across a 100 mm wafer
items.description: Mapping with a masked quartz sensor gave a thickness variation of 1.2 percent across the wafer. The uniformity mask was adjusted twice.

items.title: Compact record of multilayer recipes
items.description: Table of recipes for Mo/Si, W/B4C, Ni/C and Cr/Sc. Each row lists target power, pressure, rotation speed and expected period.

items.title: XRR scan of MS-0417 at Cu K-alpha
items.description: Specular reflectivity from 0.2 to 6 degrees. First Bragg peak at 1.21 degrees. The fitted period is 6.9 nm and the interface roughness is 0.4 nm. Fit quality is good up to the fifth order.

items.title: Рефлектометрия образца MS-0418 с барьерами B4C
items.description: Положение брэгговских пиков соответствует периоду 6,6 нм. Шероховатость на границах Mo-на-Si снизилась до 0,3 нм по сравнению с образцом без барьеров.

items.title: Fitting strategy for multilayers with many parameters
items.description: Fit the period first, then thicknesses of individual layers, then roughness. Fixing densities at bulk values avoids unphysical solutions. A global optimiser is run before the local one.

items.title: Ошибка юстировки образца при измерении XRR
items.description: Образец был смещён относительно оси гониометра на 0,2 мм. Кривая сдвинулась на 0,03 градуса. Правило: перед каждым измерением выполнять сканирование по высоте и по наклону.

items.title: Detector saturation during the first Bragg peak
items.description: The peak count rate exceeded the linear range of the scintillation detector. An attenuator foil was inserted. Measurements before this change must not be used for peak height.

items.title: AFM of silicon substrates: roughness survey
items.description: Ten substrates were scanned over 2x2 micrometres. RMS roughness 0.15 to 0.30 nm. Two wafers with scratches were rejected. Images stored with the sample records.

items.title: Эллипсометрия естественного оксида на кремнии
items.description: Толщина слоя SiO2 на пластинах Si(100) составляет 1,8-2,2 нм. Измерения проводились на длинах волн 400-800 нм, использована модель Коши.

items.title: Ellipsometry of native silicon oxide on wafers
items.description: Native oxide thickness on freshly cleaned Si(100) is 1.5 nm and grows to 2.2 nm after two weeks in air. Spectra between 300 and 900 nm were fitted with a Cauchy model.

items.title: Диффузное рассеяние рентгеновского излучения на многослойных плёнках
items.description: Карты обратного пространства показывают коррелированную шероховатость с длиной корреляции около 60 нм. Измерение выполнено на лабораторном дифрактометре.

items.title: Grazing-incidence XRD of the molybdenum layers
items.description: Mo layers are polycrystalline with a (110) texture for thickness above 3 nm, and amorphous below 2 nm. Crystalline size grows with thickness.

items.title: Calibration of the goniometer zero
items.description: The zero offset of the 2theta axis is 0.012 degrees. Determined from the direct beam and the half-cut of a silicon wafer. File zero_calib_0912.dat holds the scans.

items.title: XRR-2231 repeat measurement after storage
items.description: The same sample was measured after 30 days. The period did not change within 0.02 nm. The surface oxide grew by 0.3 nm.

items.title: Повторное измерение XRR-2232 после отжига
items.description: Период уменьшился на 0,12 нм после отжига при 300 °C. Пики стали шире. Выводы по причине пока не сделаны.

items.title: Transmission electron microscopy of a Mo/Si cross-section
items.description: TEM image shows amorphous Si layers and crystalline Mo layers. The interlayers of MoSi2 are 1.1 nm thick at the Mo-on-Si interface and 0.6 nm at the other.

items.title: Просвечивающая электронная микроскопия: подготовка срезов
items.description: Тонкие срезы готовили фокусированным ионным пучком. Толщина ламели 80 нм. Для защиты поверхности наносили слой платины.

items.title: Software note: batch fit script for XRR files
items.description: Python script reads all dat files in a folder, fits the period and writes a table. It stops with an error if the file has a non-numeric header line.

files.name: batch_fit.py

items.title: Измерение оптических констант молибдена по рефлектометрии
items.description: Дельта и бета определены по критическому углу на длине волны 0,154 нм. Значения совпадают с таблицей Хенке в пределах 2 процентов.

items.title: X-ray fluorescence check of layer composition
items.description: XRF showed an oxygen-free stack, with Mo to Si ratio matching the design within 3 percent. The method has no depth resolution.

items.title: Планируется: нейтронная рефлектометрия изотопных слоёв
items.description: Запланировано, но пока не выполнено. Нужна заявка на реактор и образец с изотопом 11B. Срок подачи заявки в ноябре.

items.title: Interface roughness: comparison of XRR and AFM
items.description: AFM roughness of the top surface was 0.35 nm, XRR gave 0.38 nm. The agreement shows that the Mo-on-Si interface is not much rougher than the surface.

items.title: Reflectivity at 13.5 nm measured on the laboratory source
items.description: A laser plasma source with a grating monochromator gave 66 percent peak reflectivity for MS-0417. The measurement was completed and the curve is attached.

items.title: Измерение на длине волны 13,5 нм: оценка погрешности
items.description: Систематическая погрешность определяется нестабильностью источника и составляет 1,5 процента. Для снижения ошибки усредняют 50 импульсов.

items.title: Sample holder misalignment found with an optical level
items.description: The tilt of the sample stage was 0.05 degrees. It was fixed by adding shims. Earlier XRR curves show a small shift in angle.

items.title: Grain size analysis from rocking curves
items.description: Rocking curve width of the Mo (110) peak gives a coherence length of 12 nm. This agrees with TEM images. Data file rocking_mo110.dat.

items.title: Сравнение методов измерения толщины: XRR, эллипсометрия, TEM
items.description: Для плёнок Mo толщиной 30 нм все три метода дают результат в пределах 1 нм. Эллипсометрия быстрее, но зависит от модели.

items.title: XRR on samples without annealing: reference set
items.description: Reference curves of as-deposited samples for comparison with annealed ones. No thermal treatment was applied to any sample in this set.

items.title: Beam footprint correction in XRR
items.description: At low angles the beam footprint exceeds the sample length. The correction factor is applied below 0.5 degrees. Incorrect handling gives intensity errors up to 30 percent.

items.title: Рентгеновская рефлектометрия: что измерено, а что предложено
items.description: Выполнены измерения образцов MS-0417 и MS-0418. Измерения MS-0430 предложены, но не сделаны, потому что образец ещё на нанесении защитного слоя.

items.title: Roughness model comparison: Debye-Waller versus Nevot-Croce
items.description: Both models fit the data of smooth samples equally well. Differences appear above 4 degrees and for roughness above 0.6 nm.

items.title: Lab note on XRR sample mounting
items.description: Use double-sided tape only for cheap test pieces. Real samples are held by vacuum chuck. Avoid any strain of thin wafers because it bends the surface.

items.title: Vacuum annealing of Mo/Si at 400 C: period contraction
items.description: After 2 hours at 400 C the period shrank by 0.25 nm and the reflectivity fell by 8 percent. MoSi2 growth at the interfaces explains the contraction.

items.title: Отжиг Mo/Si с барьерами B4C: результаты при 500 °C
items.description: Образцы с барьерами B4C сохранили период после 2 часов отжига при 500 °C, уменьшение не превысило 0,03 нм. Барьеры существенно повышают термостабильность.

items.title: Corrosion of Ni/C mirrors in humid air
items.description: After six weeks at 60 percent humidity the top carbon layer swelled and started to peel at the edges. Reflectivity fell from 71 to 55 percent. Storage in a desiccator is advised.

items.title: Деградация зеркал при хранении на воздухе
items.description: Через месяц плёнка потемнела и местами отслоилась, видны следы коррозии. Образцы из партии, хранившейся в эксикаторе, остались без изменений.

items.title: Annealing oven temperature calibration
items.description: A thermocouple mounted on the sample holder reads 14 C lower than the controller at 400 C. A correction table was entered in the controller.

items.title: Plan: annealing series 200 to 600 C for W/B4C
items.description: Proposed. Ten samples, steps of 50 C, 1 h each. Sample preparation is not finished yet, so no result exists.

items.title: Отжиг W/B4C: серия завершена
items.description: Серия образцов отожжена при 200-600 °C. Период сохранялся до 450 °C, выше начиналось размытие слоёв. Данные рефлектометрии приложены.

items.title: Oxidation of the top silicon layer in air
items.description: Native oxide on the topmost Si layer grows to 2 nm within a month, then saturates. A capping layer of 2 nm Ru stops the growth.

items.title: Ruthenium capping layer: test of lifetime
items.description: Samples with a 2 nm Ru cap were exposed to EUV radiation for 100 h in poor vacuum. Carbon contamination was 0.4 nm. Uncapped samples showed 1.1 nm of oxide.

items.title: Влияние влажности на адгезию слоёв
items.description: При влажности выше 70 процентов краевое отслоение наблюдалось через 10 суток. Хранение при влажности 30 процентов исключило отслоение на срок до полугода.

items.title: Thermal cycling test between 20 and 150 C
items.description: Fifty cycles did not change the period or the roughness. No cracks were found in optical microscopy. The film stress changed by less than 5 percent.

items.title: Радиационная стойкость: облучение пучком электронов
items.description: Образцы облучали электронами 10 кэВ дозой 1e17 электронов на см2. Рост углеродного слоя на поверхности составил 0,6 нм. Отражение не изменилось.

items.title: Hydrogen exposure of Mo/Si: no blistering observed
items.description: Samples were kept in hydrogen plasma for 8 h. We observed neither blisters nor delamination. This is a good result for cleaning in EUV scanners.

items.title: Blistering of Mo/Si caused by hydrogen implantation
items.description: In another run with higher ion energy (500 eV) blisters of 1 to 3 micrometres appeared. The cause is trapped hydrogen in silicon. The sample is not suitable for use.

items.title: Хранение образцов в азоте: план эксперимента
items.description: Предложено хранить 10 образцов в азотном боксе и 10 на воздухе. Измерения через 1, 3 и 6 месяцев. Эксперимент ещё не запущен.

items.title: Long-term stability study of MS-0417: one year
items.description: The sample was measured at 0, 3, 6 and 12 months. The period is stable within 0.02 nm and the peak reflectivity changed by 1 percent. Study completed.

items.title: Дефекты поверхности после отжига: микроскопия
items.description: После отжига при 600 °C на поверхности появились кристаллиты размером около 200 нм. Они видны в оптической и атомно-силовой микроскопии.

items.title: Interdiffusion model for annealed multilayers
items.description: A simple diffusion model with activation energy 1.8 eV reproduces the period contraction of Mo/Si between 300 and 450 C. Silicide growth follows a parabolic law.

items.title: Energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy after annealing
items.description: EDS line scans across the film section show oxygen at the top and a mix of Mo and Si in the middle. The resolution of EDS is not enough for single layers.

items.title: Тест на устойчивость к ацетону и спирту
items.description: Многослойные плёнки выдержали 10 минут в ацетоне и изопропаноле без видимых изменений. Ультразвуковая очистка не рекомендуется для зеркал.

items.title: Cryogenic cycling to 77 K: planned
items.description: Proposed test in liquid nitrogen, not performed. Needs a holder with slow cooling to avoid cracks. Waiting for the new cryostat insert.

items.title: Effect of residual gas on annealing: oxygen versus vacuum
items.description: Annealing in 1e-4 mbar oxygen gives a 1.5 nm thicker top oxide than annealing at 1e-7 mbar. The inner layers are not affected.

items.title: Разрушение зеркала при термоударе
items.description: При быстром нагреве до 300 °C на стеклянной подложке возникли трещины. На кремнии трещин нет. Скорость нагрева должна быть ниже 5 °C в минуту.

items.title: Corrosion test in salt fog: negative result
items.description: Salt fog exposure for 24 h destroyed the top layers of all uncapped samples. This is expected and is not a concern for vacuum use.

items.title: Table of annealing results for all series
items.description: Summary: Mo/Si loses 0.25 nm of period at 400 C, Mo/Si with B4C loses 0.03 nm at 500 C, W/B4C keeps its period up to 450 C, Ni/C is stable up to 300 C.

items.title: Samples without any thermal treatment: control group
items.description: Control samples were stored at room temperature while others were annealed. They show no change in period and roughness over the same time.

items.title: Измерение тепловой проводимости многослойной плёнки
items.description: Метод трёх омега показал теплопроводность поперёк слоёв 1,2 Вт/(м·К). Интерфейсы дают основной вклад в термическое сопротивление.

items.title: Review of silicide growth literature
items.description: Notes from 12 papers about MoSi2 and Mo5Si3 formation in thin films. Thickness of the silicide grows with the square root of time at constant temperature.

items.title: Ageing under EUV: dose planning
items.description: Plan only. We want to expose three samples to 1e6 pulses each at 13.5 nm. The beam time request is pending and no data exist.

items.title: Silicon wafer cleaning protocol: RCA-1 and RCA-2
items.description: Wafers are cleaned in ammonia-peroxide, then in hydrochloric acid-peroxide, 10 min each at 75 C, and rinsed in deionised water. A last dip in dilute HF removes the oxide. Use gloves and a fume hood.

files.name: rca_protocol_v2.txt
files.text: Step 1: SC-1 NH4OH:H2O2:H2O 1:1:5, 75 C, 10 min. Step 2: rinse 5 min. Step 3: SC-2 HCl:H2O2:H2O 1:1:6, 75 C, 10 min. Step 4: rinse, nitrogen dry.

items.title: Очистка подложек перед напылением: ультразвук и плазма
items.description: Подложки очищают в ультразвуковой ванне с ацетоном и спиртом по 10 минут, затем обрабатывают кислородной плазмой 2 минуты. После очистки подложки сразу помещают в камеру.

items.title: Superpolished substrates: incoming inspection
items.description: Each substrate is checked by interferometry and AFM. Acceptance limit is 0.2 nm RMS in the 1 to 10 micrometre band. Two of twelve substrates failed.

items.title: Подложки из плавленого кварца: поставщик и качество
items.description: Заказано 20 пластин диаметром 50 мм. Шероховатость по паспорту 0,3 нм, измеренная на АСМ 0,35 нм. Задержка поставки составила три недели.

items.title: Turbomolecular pump vibration problem
items.description: The pump HV-PUMP-03 produced vibrations that blurred AFM images on the same table. A damping mount cut the amplitude by a factor of 5.

items.title: Журнал обслуживания HV-PUMP-01
items.description: Замена масла в форвакуумном насосе выполнена. Время откачки до 1e-6 мбар сократилось с 90 до 55 минут. Следующее обслуживание через 6 месяцев.

items.title: Cryopump regeneration procedure
items.description: Regenerate when the pressure rises above 5e-7 mbar. Warm the pump to 300 K with the valve closed, purge with nitrogen, then cool again. Whole cycle takes four hours.

items.title: Hydrocarbon contamination in the load lock
items.description: Mass spectrometer shows peaks at mass 41, 43 and 57 after venting. A bake of the load lock at 120 C for 12 h removed them.

items.title: Остаточные газы в камере: анализ масс-спектрометром
items.description: Основные пики: вода (18), азот (28), аргон (40). После прогрева камеры доля воды упала втрое. Давление 3e-8 мбар достигнуто через 24 часа.

items.title: Argon gas line: mass flow controller calibration
items.description: The 20 sccm controller reads 7 percent high compared with the bubble meter. The correction factor 0.93 is entered in the recipe software.

items.title: Chiller for magnetron cooling: failure
items.description: The chiller tripped because the water filter was blocked. Targets were warm for 20 minutes but not damaged. The filter is now cleaned every month.

items.title: Safety instruction: handling of liquid nitrogen
items.description: Wear face shield and gloves. Never close a vessel with a tight cap. Transport only in approved dewars. Training record must be signed.

items.title: Правила работы с плавиковой кислотой
items.description: Работа только в вытяжном шкафу, в защитных перчатках и маске. Гель с глюконатом кальция хранится в аптечке. Отходы собираются в отдельную ёмкость.

items.title: Sample storage boxes: inventory
items.description: All finished samples are stored in numbered boxes in a desiccator cabinet. Box 4 holds the MS series, box 5 the W/B4C series. Inventory list is attached.

items.title: Вакуумный шлюз: замена уплотнений
items.description: Резиновые кольца шлюза заменены на витоновые. Течь по гелиевому течеискателю не обнаружена. Работы заняли два дня.

items.title: Ion gun alignment for substrate etching
items.description: The Ar+ ion gun beam was centred on the substrate using a Faraday cup. Current density 0.5 mA per cm2 at 300 eV. Etch rate of silicon is 1.2 nm per minute.

items.title: Планируется закупка нового кварцевого датчика
items.description: Заявка на покупку подготовлена, но не подана. Стоимость 1200 евро. Датчик нужен для замены изношенного.

items.title: Gold coating of substrates for adhesion tests
items.description: Planned only. A 50 nm gold underlayer is meant to test if it improves the adhesion of Ni/C on glass. Gold target has not arrived.

items.title: Residual stress of bare substrates
items.description: Silicon wafers bend by less than 2 micrometres over 100 mm. Glass substrates bend more, up to 8 micrometres, which complicates stress measurements.

items.title: Plasma cleaner chamber maintenance
items.description: Quartz tube replaced after 500 hours. Oxygen line checked. Plasma ignition now stable at 50 W. Maintenance record updated.

items.title: Протокол: хранение мишеней в вакуумных пакетах
items.description: Новые мишени хранят в вакуумных пакетах с силикагелем. Перед установкой проверяют внешний вид и отсутствие окисления. Мишень Sc хранится только в аргоне.

items.title: Magnetron cathode installation checklist
items.description: Check the water connection, the shield gap of 2 mm and the electrical insulation. Test resistance to the ground must exceed 1 megaohm. Photograph the installed target.

items.title: Replacement of the quartz crystal monitor head
items.description: The head was replaced when the crystal life fell below 10 percent. The tooling factor must be recalibrated with a thick reference film.

items.title: Подготовка образцов для нейтронных измерений
items.description: Образцы разрезаны на куски 25x25 мм, края защищены от повреждений. Для хранения использовались пластиковые контейнеры. Рефлектометрия не планировалась.

items.title: Dust control in the clean area
items.description: Particle counter shows 2000 particles per litre above 0.5 micrometre. Target is below 1000. Laminar flow hood filters were changed.

items.title: Contact angle test of cleaned substrates
items.description: Water contact angle on RCA-cleaned silicon is below 5 degrees; on acetone-cleaned silicon it is 30 to 40 degrees. The test is quick and shows the cleanliness.

items.title: Log of power outage on the vacuum system
items.description: A power cut stopped all pumps. The gate valve closed automatically. No damage. An uninterruptible supply for the controller was ordered.

items.title: Cleaning solution waste: disposal routine
items.description: Acid and solvent waste go into separate marked canisters. The canisters are collected by the safety office every second Thursday. Records of volume are kept.

items.title: Protein-free cleaning agent for optical surfaces
items.description: Supplier data for a cleaning agent used on optics. It contains no protein-digesting enzymes and no cell-culture components. Compatible with glass, quartz and coated silicon.

items.title: Beamtime BL-12 summary: reflectivity of mirrors at 8 keV
items.description: Three nights at the synchrotron beamline BL-12. We measured angular scans of six W/B4C mirrors. Data files bl12_run_001 to bl12_run_042 are stored in the project folder.

items.title: Сеанс на синхротроне BL-12: ошибки и уроки
items.description: Из-за нестабильности пучка потеряно около 6 часов. Рекомендация: перед каждой серией проверять положение щелей и ток накопителя.

items.title: Beamline slit calibration procedure
items.description: Scan each slit across the beam and record the half-maximum point. Offsets of up to 20 micrometres were found and are now stored in the control file.

items.title: Focusing mirror alignment at the soft X-ray source
items.description: Pitch and roll were adjusted with a CCD at the focus. Spot size 80 micrometres FWHM. The adjustment takes about 40 minutes.

items.title: Laser plasma source: nozzle erosion
items.description: The xenon nozzle eroded after 3e7 shots and the EUV output fell by 40 percent. A new nozzle restored it. Spare nozzles are in the cabinet.

items.title: Монохроматор для области 13,5 нм: настройка решётки
items.description: Решётка 1200 штрихов на миллиметр. Разрешение по длине волны 0,02 нм. Настройка занимает один день, нулевой порядок используется для проверки.

items.title: EUV photodiode calibration against a reference
items.description: The AXUV diode was compared with a calibrated reference. Responsivity 0.21 A/W at 13.5 nm, within 3 percent of the certificate.

items.title: Data analysis pipeline for reflectivity curves
items.description: A Python package reads raw files, subtracts dark counts, normalises by the incident beam and writes a table. Version 0.4 adds logging and unit tests.

files.name: pipeline_readme.txt
files.text: Run: python -m refl.run input_dir output_dir. Requires numpy and scipy. Dark counts are taken from the first ten points.

items.title: Конвейер анализа данных: ошибка нормировки
items.description: В версии 0.3 нормировка делилась на ток накопителя дважды. Все результаты, полученные этой версией, нужно пересчитать версией 0.4.

items.title: Machine learning model to predict multilayer reflectivity
items.description: A small neural network was trained on 50 thousand simulated stacks. It predicts the peak reflectivity with 1 percent error and runs a thousand times faster than the transfer-matrix code.

items.title: Нейронная сеть для подгонки рефлектометрических кривых
items.description: Предложена архитектура, обучение не проведено. Данные для обучения будут получены расчётом по матричному методу.

items.title: Transfer-matrix code: validation against a textbook example
items.description: The code reproduces the reflectivity of a Si/SiO2 bilayer to 1e-6 relative error. Parratt recursion gives identical numbers.

items.title: Weekly meeting notes: priorities for the quarter
items.description: Priorities: finish annealing series for W/B4C, repair the sputtering controller, submit the beamtime proposal. Proposed new topic: La/B mirrors for 6.7 nm.

items.title: Протокол совещания: распределение времени на установке
items.description: Установка напыления занята по понедельникам и средам. Рефлектометр свободен ежедневно. Пятница используется для обслуживания.

items.title: Beam time proposal for the 2025 cycle
items.description: Proposal submitted for 12 shifts at BL-12 to study thermal stability in situ. Status: submitted, not yet accepted. Decision expected in January.

items.title: In situ annealing setup at the beamline: design
items.description: Heating stage with Kapton windows, maximum 600 C. Drawing and heat load calculation completed. The workshop has not yet built it.

items.title: Бюджет проекта: расходные материалы за год
items.description: Мишени 9500 евро, подложки 3200 евро, газы 800 евро, обслуживание насосов 1500 евро. Расходы по мишеням превышают план на 12 процентов.

items.title: Student training record: sputtering system
items.description: Two students finished the training on the sputtering system and signed the safety sheet. A short exam on vacuum safety was passed.

items.title: Результаты сравнения двух лабораторий: круговой тест
items.description: Два образца измерены в двух лабораториях. Расхождение по периоду 0,02 нм, по пиковому отражению 2 процента. Согласие считается хорошим.

items.title: Round-robin on XRR fitting with three groups
items.description: The same curve was fitted by three groups with different software. Periods agree within 0.01 nm, roughness values differ by 0.2 nm, depending on the model.

items.title: Poster draft for the conference on X-ray optics
items.description: Abstract and layout of the poster: Mo/Si with barrier layers, thermal stability and long-term ageing. Draft only. Figures have to be redone in vector format.

items.title: Подготовка статьи: структура и распределение ролей
items.description: Предложена структура статьи из пяти разделов. Первый автор пишет введение и методы. Раздел о термостабильности ждёт данных отжига.

items.title: Bibliography file for the thermal stability paper
items.description: List of 40 references with DOI. Duplicates removed. A few entries have no page numbers and need checking.

files.name: refs_thermal.bib
files.text: @article{Smith1999, title={Silicide formation in thin films}, year={1999}}

items.title: Laboratory network storage layout
items.description: Raw data go to the folder raw, processed tables to processed, figures to figures. Use the date and the sample code in file names. Back-up runs every night.

items.title: Лабораторный журнал: правила именования образцов
items.description: Код образца состоит из префикса серии и номера, например MS-0417. Образцы с барьерами обозначаются суффиксом B. Коды не используются повторно.

items.title: Uncertainty budget for peak reflectivity
items.description: Contributions: source stability 1.5 percent, detector linearity 0.8 percent, alignment 1.0 percent, normalisation 0.5 percent. Combined uncertainty 2.1 percent.

items.title: Test of a new area detector for diffuse scattering
items.description: The detector has 1024x1024 pixels and a dynamic range of 1e6. Hot pixels were masked. Tests with a rough sample are planned for next month.

items.title: Instruction: opening a new notebook entry for each run
items.description: Every deposition and every measurement needs its own entry with sample code, date and operator. Attach raw files directly to the entry.

items.title: Thermal expansion mismatch between film and substrate
items.description: Calculated stress from the difference of expansion coefficients between Mo, Si and glass. The stress at 400 C reaches 300 MPa on glass and 120 MPa on silicon.

items.title: Calculation of the mirror reflectivity for 6.7 nm radiation
items.description: Preliminary calculation shows that La/B stacks could reach 70 percent at 6.7 nm if interfaces are smooth to 0.3 nm. This is a calculation only, no sample exists.

items.title: Результаты расчёта: многослойное зеркало для излучения 3,1 нм
items.description: Для пары Cr/Sc расчётная отражательная способность около 40 процентов при нормальном падении. Образцов пока нет.

items.title: Sample shipment to the partner institute
items.description: Four Mo/Si samples were sent in sealed boxes with silica gel. Tracking number is stored in the entry. Return is expected in three weeks.
